meta.name: hyperframes-core
meta.description: The HyperFrames composition contract — build one renderable project. Use for composition structure, the `data-*` timing attributes, `class="clip"`, tracks, sub-compositions, variables, framework-owned media playback, deterministic-render rules, and validation. Also covers Tailwind projects and the STORYBOARD.md / SCRIPT.md plan formats. Read before writing composition HTML.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 制作按时间轴编排的可渲染视觉
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果你希望通过代码和 HTML 亲手制作动态影像作品
copy.tagline_en: Create renderable visual scenes timed by code
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you want to craft dynamic animations with code and HTML.

howto.what: 装上后,Claude 会用 HyperFrames 的技术规范帮你构建或修改可渲染的视频项目:用 HTML 加 data-* 属性控制时间,媒体播放交给框架,并遵守确定性规则,确保可渲染可校验。
howto.when: 当你要做 HyperFrames 相关的视频合成或修改时触发,比如编写 composition HTML、设置 data-* 时间属性、管理轨道/子合成,或写 STORYBOARD.md/SCRIPT.md 计划等。

say.text: 用 HyperFrames 帮我搭一个最小的可渲染合成。
say.note: 会按最小合成骨架生成 HTML。

say.text: 检查这个 index.html 符不符合 HyperFrames 规范。
say.note: 会运行校验并指出问题。

say.text: 给我的项目写一个 STORYBOARD.md 计划。
say.note: 生成计划并按规范组织。

howto.what_en: When installed, Claude follows the HyperFrames technical contract to build or edit renderable video projects: compose HTML with data-* timing attributes, let the framework own media playback, and follow deterministic-render and validation rules.
howto.when_en: Triggers when you ask to create or modify a HyperFrames composition, e.g. writing composition HTML, setting data-* timing attributes, managing tracks/sub-compositions, or drafting STORYBOARD.md/SCRIPT.md plans.

say_en.text: Help me build a minimal renderable HyperFrames composition.

Write a STORYBOARD.md plan for my project.
